what: a circle of radius 5 swept 20 mm up a straight path with one guide rail from its point (5,0,0) to (10,0,20)
method: the profile is scaled by the rail distance from the path, 5 at the start and 10 at the end, linearly: a cone frustum, V = h/3 (A1 + A2 + sqrt(A1 A2)) = 20/3 pi (25 + 100 + 50) = 3665.2.
